description_sq:
Ofrojme Apartament 1+1 per shitje tek Rruga Sali Butka, ne nje objekt te vitit 2015, te mire administruar e te mirembajtur.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e kater me orientim lindje, organizohet ne nje sallon ndenje me ambjent gatimi, dhome gjumi, tualet, korridor dhe ballkon.
Apartamenti eshte totalisht i investuar ne menyre cilesore dhe ofrohet per shitje i mobiluar.
Mundesi shume e mire per te jetuar ne nje zone prane te gjithe fasiliteteve dhe nje objekt te ri.
Mundesi blerje garazhd te mbyllur me cmim ekstra.
Per me teper infomracion mos hezitoni te me kontaktoni.
description_en: We offer 1+1 Apartment for sale on Sali Butka Street, in a building built in 2015, well managed and well maintained. The apartment is located on the fourth floor facing east, it is organized in a living room with a kitchen area, a bedroom, a toilet, a corridor and a balcony. The apartment is fully invested in quality and is offered for sale furnished. Very good opportunity to live in an area near all facilities and a new building. Possibility of buying a closed garage at an extra price. For more information, do not hesitate to contact me.
